talents.name: Ice Barrier

ranks.description: Instantly shields you, absorbing 431 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.

talents.iconHint: Blue/white ice shield (tooltip-only in 1.png; icon visible in 50.png)
talents.diffNotes: Classic absorb was 455 at the ranks.json sample; Forever shows 431 absorb and lists 30 sec cooldown / 305 mana.

talents.name: Arcane Subtlety

ranks.description: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 8 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 15%.
Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

talents.diffNotes: Rank 1 changed from Classic 5 resist / 20% threat to 8 resist / 15% threat. Rank 2 text matches Classic foundation (15 / 30%).

talents.name: Arcane Concentration

ranks.description: Gives you a 2% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
Gives you a 8% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.iconHint: Purple/white magical burst or figure emitting blue beam
talents.diffNotes: Rank percentages match Classic 2/4/6/8/10% Clearcasting. Layout may differ from Classic row1 col2.

talents.name: Wand Specialization

ranks.description: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

talents.iconHint: Hand with blue glowing wand / energy burst; green border rank 0
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1 (13%).

talents.name: Magic Absorption

ranks.description: Increases all your resistances by 5 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

talents.iconHint: Swirling purple/pink energy or blue silhouette with radiating white energy
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1 text.

talents.name: Arcane Mind

ranks.description: Increases your Intellect by 2% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 20%.
Increases your Intellect by 6% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 60%.
Increases your Intellect by 8% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 80%.

talents.iconHint: Side profile of head with arcane energy at forehead / shadowy purple face
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Intellect % and Arcane crit damage bonus progression. Dependency arrow from talent above visible in shots.

talents.name: Arcane Instability

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by all your spells by 1% and your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.
Increases the damage done by all your spells by 3% and your critical strike chance with all attacks by 3%.

talents.iconHint: Head with blue energy from eyes/skull / dark purple face
talents.diffNotes: Classic: '+spell damage and critical strike chance by N%'. Forever: damage of all spells + crit chance with all attacks. Also moved to row5 col2 (Classic was row5 col1).

talents.name: Arcane Resilience

ranks.description: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 25% of your Intellect.

talents.diffNotes: Classic was 1 rank at 50% Intellect armor. Forever is 2 ranks at 25% Intellect (rank 1 preview). Likely moved off Classic row2 col2.

talents.name: Arcane Geometry

ranks.description: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 3 yards.

talents.iconHint: Circular brown/grey arcane sigil with nested triangles
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Range talent for Arcane spells (Magic Attunement was Amplify/Dampen effect, not range).

talents.name: Arcane Impact

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 2%.

talents.iconHint: Purple and white swirling energy blast
talents.diffNotes: Likely renamed/replaced Improved Arcane Explosion (classicId 81). Classic was Arcane Explosion crit only; Forever is all Arcane spells +2% crit per rank.

talents.name: Arcane Shielding

ranks.description: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 17% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 25%.

talents.diffNotes: Renamed from Improved Mana Shield. Classic was 10%/20% mana-loss reduction only. Forever adds Mage Armor resistance and uses 17% at rank 1.

talents.name: Improved Counterspell

ranks.description: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 2 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was 50% chance to silence for 4 sec. Forever rank 1 is a guaranteed 2 sec silence.

talents.name: Arcane Meditation

ranks.description: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.diffNotes: Classic was 5/10/15%. Forever rank 1 preview shows 17%.

talents.name: Missile Barrage

ranks.description: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles will fire every 0.5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only (WotLK-era style proc). Mentions Arcane Blast / Frostfire Bolt which are not Classic 1.12 baseline.

talents.name: Presence of Mind

ranks.description: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.diffNotes: Effect text matches Classic; cooldown (3 min) explicitly shown in tooltip.

talents.name: Wake of Fire

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 1 sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within 20 sec by 25%.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Related to Fire Blast but distinct from Improved Fire Blast (CD-only).

talents.name: Pyroblast

ranks.description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 155 to 185 Fire damage and an additional 76 Fire damage over 12 sec.

talents.iconHint: Bright fiery boulder / explosion; green border rank 0
talents.diffNotes: Damage numbers differ from Classic placeholder (148–195 + 56 DoT). Still 6 sec cast / 1 rank.

talents.name: Burning Soul

ranks.description: Gives your Fire spells a 23% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic maxRank 2 at 35%/15% and 70%/30%. Forever maxRank 3 with rank 1 at 23% pushback resist / 10% threat.

talents.name: Improved Scorch

ranks.description: Your Scorch spell has a 33% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.iconHint: Concentrated orange/yellow fire blast; greyed at 0
talents.diffNotes: Wording: Classic 'Fire damage dealt to your target' → Forever 'all Fire damage you deal to your target'. Same 33%/3%/5 stacks structure.

talents.name: Improved Fire Ward

ranks.description: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 10% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1.

talents.name: Hot Streak

ranks.description: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 15 sec. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

talents.iconHint: Hand/claw surrounded by orange flames; dependency arrow from above
talents.diffNotes: Forever-only. Stacking Pyroblast cast-time reduction (not the WotLK instant-after-2-crits version).

talents.name: Master of Elements

ranks.description: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 10% of their base mana cost.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1 refund value; minor wording ('critical strikes' vs 'spell criticals').

talents.name: Critical Mass

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1.

talents.name: Blast Wave

ranks.description: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 160 to 191 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Explicit 50% movement-speed daze and specific damage band; Classic text said 'dazing them for 6 sec' with different placeholder damage.

talents.name: Fire Power

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2%.

talents.iconHint: Greyscale hand with flame above palm
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1 (+2%).

talents.name: Combustion

ranks.description: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 4 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

talents.iconHint: Dark silhouette on fiery orange; dependency from above
talents.diffNotes: Classic ended after 3 Fire crits. Forever: 4 non-periodic critical strikes.

talents.name: Frost Warding

ranks.description: Increases the Armor and resistance given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 15%. In addition, gives your Frost Ward a 10% chance to reflect Frost spells and effects while active.

talents.iconHint: Bright white multi-point snowflake / frost burst
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1.

talents.name: Improved Frostbolt

ranks.description: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.1 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1.

talents.name: Elemental Precision

ranks.description: Increases your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by 1%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic was maxRank 3 reducing resist chance by 2% per rank. Forever is maxRank 5 granting +1% hit per rank.

talents.name: Ice Shards

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 20%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1.

talents.name: Permafrost

ranks.description: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 11% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 3%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1: +1 sec Chill duration and +4% slow. Forever: +11% duration and +3% slow.

talents.name: Improved Frost Nova

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 2 sec.

talents.iconHint: Bright blue glowing oval on dark background
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1.

talents.name: Frostbite

ranks.description: Gives your Chill effects a 5% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1. Overview suggests Classic row1 col1 may be empty in Forever — possible layout move.

talents.name: Improved Blizzard

ranks.description: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 15% for 1.5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 Chill was 30% slow for 1.50 sec. Forever rank 1 is 15% for 1.5 sec.

talents.name: Ice Lance

ranks.description: Deals 28 to 33 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

talents.iconHint: Glowing slanted blue ice shard; green border rank 0; arrow down toward Fingers of Frost
talents.diffNotes: Forever talent spell (not in Classic 1.12 Mage tree).

talents.name: Frost Channeling

ranks.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 5% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1.

talents.name: Piercing Ice

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 2%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1.

talents.name: Arctic Reach

ranks.description: Increases the range of your Frostbolt and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1.

talents.name: Ice Block

ranks.description: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

talents.diffNotes: Effect matches Classic; mana (15) and 5 min CD explicitly listed.

talents.name: Cold Snap

ranks.description: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

talents.diffNotes: Classic: finishes cooldown on all Frost spells. Forever: 'all your other Frost spells' with 10 min CD listed.

talents.name: Improved Cone of Cold

ranks.description: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 12%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was +15% damage. Forever rank 1 is +12%.

talents.name: Winter's Chill

ranks.description: Gives your Frost damage spells a 20% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the chance your Ice Lance and Frostbolt spells will critically hit the target by 2% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 1 times.

talents.diffNotes: Classic applied to Frost spell crits in general and stacked up to 5. Forever names Ice Lance and Frostbolt; screenshot text reads 'Stacks up to 1 times' (verify in-game — OCR may have misread 5).

talents.name: Fingers of Frost

ranks.description: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 1 spell cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.iconHint: Claw-like hand with icy glowing fingertips; dependency arrow from above (Ice Lance)
talents.diffNotes: Forever-only Frost talent.

layoutNotes: Overview shows Primary tab with 29 unspent points; Secondary tab locked. Webcam overlay in bottom-left of overview is not part of the UI.

Arcane: Forever has an extra occupied slot at row1 col3 vs Classic. Classic Arcane Resilience (row2 col2) appears vacated; a new/moved talent sits at row2 col3. Arcane Instability appears moved to row5 col2 (Classic row5 col1). Dependency arrows: row1 col2 → row3 col2; row4 col1 → row6 col1 (not Classic Presence of Mind → Arcane Instability → Arcane Power chain).

Fire: Tier 1 shifted left and gained a third talent (row0 cols 0–2 vs Classic cols 1–2 only). Classic Burning Soul at row2 col3 vacated. New Hot Streak / Wake of Fire fill reshuffled mid-tree slots. Capstone arrow is Critical Mass (row4 col1) → Combustion (row6 col1).

Frost: Ice Lance appears at row2 col2 (empty in Classic) with arrow to Fingers of Frost at row4 col2. Classic Shatter row3 col2 looks empty; a burst icon at row3 col3 may be Shatter relocated. Frostbite may have left Classic row1 col1 (empty in overview).

Screenshots do not cover every Classic talent by name (e.g. Arcane Focus, Improved Arcane Missiles, Improved Fireball, Impact, Ignite, Shatter, Arcane Power, Magic Attunement). Those slots are occupied in overview but lack tooltip shots — left as guessName only.
All numbered files mage/1.png–mage/50.png are accounted for under talents (1+50 both Ice Barrier).
